description: Deterministic analytical rules. Rules create ANALYTICAL SIGNALS (never verdicts). Edit and reload with POST /api/rules/reload (ADMIN).

rules.name: Shared device across many accounts
rules.description: A device used by more than N distinct accounts within a sliding time window.

alternative_explanations: Emulator farm used for QA testing

rules.name: IP address shared by many accounts
rules.description: An IP address connected to more than N distinct accounts within a window.

rules.name: Unusual inbound transfer count
rules.description: Accounts receiving many more transfers in a window than the population's 99th percentile.

rules.name: Circular value flow
rules.description: Value that moves through a closed loop of accounts within a short period.

alternative_explanations: Treasury / cash-pool sweeps between related accounts

rules.name: DNS lookup of watch-listed domain
rules.description: A device performed a DNS lookup of a domain on the analyst watch-list.

alternative_explanations: Link preview fetched by a messaging app

rules.name: Authentication failures followed by login from same IP
rules.description: An auth_failure followed within 30 minutes by a successful login for the same account and IP.

rules.name: Activity inside Harbor Plaza geofence
rules.description: Events of selected types inside a named geofence.

alternative_explanations: Busy public location; presence is expected for many people

rules.name: New control relationship
rules.description: A new CONTROLS relationship appears in ingested data.

rules.name: Source data changed
rules.description: A previously ingested source record changed on re-ingestion.
